description: File a quote request with Cyclone Machining Co. (Grand Rapids, Michigan): prototypes, first articles, one-offs, revisions, replacement parts with or without a drawing, small runs. A person reads every request before anything is priced. Set review_only for a free engineer's review without a quote; set export_controlled when the part's data may be controlled.

agent.description: optional, the name and version of the agent filing this

description.description: required, up to 8,000 characters: what the part does, what to hold, what exists (a STEP, a PDF, a broken sample)

email.description: required, where the shop's reply goes

export_controlled.description: optional, one of no, yes, not sure: whether the part's data is export-controlled (ITAR or EAR). Yes or not sure: the answer gives no file link, and no files or controlled detail are sent until a person arranges a controlled channel

files.description: optional, [{name, bytes}] - names only; the answer to the request says where to send the files (no file link when export_controlled is yes or not sure)

material.description: optional, e.g. 6061 aluminum, 17-4 stainless, titanium, Inconel 718

no_drawing.description: optional, true when the part itself is the drawing

review_only.description: optional, true to ask for a free engineer's review of the part: no quote is sent unless asked

sent_back.description: optional, true when another shop sent the job back

sent_back_reason.description: optional, up to 500 characters: why it was sent back (a reason alone marks the request as sent back)

name: file_quote_request
title: File a quote request with Cyclone Machining Co.
